name: Ctrl-b [
description: Enter copy mode to scroll back, search, and copy text.

examples.description: Equivalent command
Paste the most recent buffer (Ctrl-b ])
Print the most recent buffer

notes: Key bindings shown assume the default prefix Ctrl-b; press the prefix, release, then press the key.
In emacs mode (default) start selection with Ctrl-Space and copy with Alt-w; with `setw -g mode-keys vi` use Space/v and Enter/y. Search with / or ? (vi) or Ctrl-s/Ctrl-r (emacs). q exits.
Ctrl-b PgUp enters copy mode and scrolls up immediately. The mouse option is on by default since tmux 3.8, so the wheel scrolls into copy mode; older versions need `set -g mouse on`.
tmux 3.7+ can show line numbers in copy mode: `set -g copy-mode-line-numbers relative` (or absolute, hybrid).

name: tmux source-file ~/.tmux.conf
description: Reload the tmux configuration without restarting.

examples.description: Reload config
Add to ~/.tmux.conf to reload with Ctrl-b r

notes: tmux reads ~/.tmux.conf or $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/tmux/tmux.conf (usually ~/.config/tmux/tmux.conf).
Common config lines: `set -g base-index 1`, `set -g renumber-windows on`, `setw -g mode-keys vi`, `set -g prefix C-a`. Mouse support is on by default since tmux 3.8 (`set -g mouse off` to disable).
Removed settings are not unset by reloading; restart the server (`tmux kill-server`) for a clean state.
tmux 3.8 applies built-in light/dark colour themes; `set -s theme terminal` restores the previous terminal-colour look.
